"""Normalisation of user-supplied lists before they are stored."""


def unique_emails(emails):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for email in emails:
        normalized = email.strip().lower()
        if not normalized:
            continue
        if normalized in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(normalized)
        result.append(normalized)
    result.sort()
    return result


def unique_tags(emails):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for email in emails:
        cleaned = email.strip().lower()
        if not cleaned:
            continue
        if cleaned in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(cleaned)
        result.append(cleaned)
    result.sort()
    return result
